title: Mesh descriptor binding 3 = AS_KHR, push TLAS, minimal ray query in fragment
purpose: Wire TLAS into the mesh renderer and implement a minimal ray query-based shadow factor with a runtime toggle.

steps.detail: In mesh material/scene descriptor set layout, add binding 3 as VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR when RT is enabled. Ensure SDR/HDR mesh pipelines share the same layout.
At draw time, use VkWriteDescriptorSetAccelerationStructureKHR + vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR to bind TLAS to binding 3. Add a throttled per-frame log: 'Pushed TLAS at binding 3 (AS_KHR)'.

In shaders/particle_mesh.frag (or the active mesh fragment shader), add GL_EXT_ray_query, declare layout(binding=3) uniform accelerationStructureEXT topLevelAS; implement hasOccluderRT(originWS, dirWS, tMax) with TerminateOnFirstHit|Opaque flags, and multiply a visibility factor into finalColor.
Add a runtime toggle (push constant/UBO) to enable/disable RT quickly for triage.

acceptance: Toggling RT flag visibly changes shading (darker under occluders)
No VUID 07990 (layout mismatch) or push-descriptor errors
Logs show TLAS push once per frame (throttled)
notes: Ensure worldPos and lightDir are in world space. Keep cost minimal (one ray query per fragment).
